hooks.name: Cleanup Temporary Markdown Files
hooks.description: Mendeteksi dan memperingatkan tentang temporary markdown files yang harus dihapus setelah digunakan

action.command:
powershell -Command "
\$input = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json
\$filePath = \$input.file.path

# Check if file is temporary markdown (contains 'test', 'temp', 'example', 'draft' in name)
if (\$filePath -match '\.(md)$' -and \$filePath -match '(test|temp|example|draft|scratch|poc|spike)') {
    Write-Host \"⚠️ Temporary markdown file detected: \$filePath\"
    Write-Host \"This file will be marked for cleanup after use.\"
}

exit 0
"
